name: Gerard Tiller
summary: Gerard Tiller is a thirsty human farmhand working outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. Tending the vineyards under the warm sun, he is always eager to trade a crisp, shiny red apple to any traveler willing to spare a skin of refreshing spring water.

sections.title: A Thirsty Farmhand
sections.body: Gerard Tiller spends his days toiling in the fields and tending the grounds outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards. Located just south of Goldshire, the vineyard produces some of Elwynn's best-known grapes, but keeping the harvest running is hard labor. Tiller is constantly parched from his chores, making him quick to barter with passing adventurers. If someone offers him a fresh skin of cool spring water, he happily repays the courtesy with fresh, shiny red apples gathered straight from the local orchards.

faq.answer: Gerard Tiller is a human farmhand stationed outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards in southern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Where can I find Gerard Tiller?
faq.answer: He stands right outside the large wooden barn at the Maclure Vineyards, located south of Goldshire and east of the Stonefield Farm.
Gerard trades a Shiny Red Apple to any traveler who brings him a skin of Refreshing Spring Water to quench his thirst.

faq.q: Does Gerard get involved in the Maclure and Stonefield feud?
faq.answer: No. While he works at the Maclure Vineyards, Gerard focuses on his chores and staying hydrated rather than meddling in the family rivalry between the Maclures and Stonefields.

angles.text: Gerard's willingness to trade fresh apples for plain spring water makes him a handy source of fruit for wandering cooks looking for simple ingredients.
